tagline: Continuous Distributed Tracing & Autonomous Root-Cause Diagnostics
primary_audience: Staff Site Reliability Engineers, Platform Architects, and VP Infrastructure

aesthetic_direction.typography: Modern ergonomic sans-serif (e.g. Plus Jakarta Sans or Geist) paired with tabular monospace numbers and code snippets (e.g. Geist Mono)
aesthetic_direction.composition: Information-dense layout with live interactive latency visualizers, side-by-side terminal output, and clear architectural diagrams

required_pages.name: features
required_pages.role: Deep dive into eBPF tracing & AI root-cause

media_guidelines: Accurate terminal screens, SVG flamegraphs, structured network topologies. No fake stock 3D robots or floating glass spheres.
anti_patterns: Generic 'All-in-one AI platform' buzzwords without technical specifics
Low-contrast grey text in dark code blocks
Identical card silhouettes for all features
